title: Monotonicity of write-address restrictions
statement: For any WordRAM instruction, if every address it writes (when it writes to an address) lies in a set $s\subseteq\mathbb Z$, then every address it writes also lies in any set $t$ containing $s$.
hypotheses_covered: An instruction whose write address, if applicable, belongs to $s$
